context: Gate on the ADR 0005 G2/G3/G4 decisions before writing code; if G2 selected a mechanism other than the retrieval hook, implement that instead and record the divergence. Add _provider_credential(capability) to src/todo_db/backends.py, invoked only from resolve_credential() after DatabaseConfig.auth_token and the environment variables have been tried and only for hosted backends. Parse TODO_DB_CREDENTIAL_COMMAND with shlex.split and run it with subprocess.run(shell=False, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=...), passing the requested capability per the G4 protocol. Contract: exit 0 with non-empty stdout yields ResolvedCredential(token, 'TODO_DB_CREDENTIAL_COMMAND', capability) after stripping surrounding whitespace only; exit 0 with empty stdout means the credential is absent, so read-only resolution may then ask for read-write exactly as the environment path does; any non-zero exit, timeout, unparsable command, missing executable, or stdout larger than the configured bound raises HostedAuthError with code E_AUTH_MISSING. Error messages carry the provider argv[0] and exit status only, never stdout, never stderr, and never the token. Extend doctor's non-secret provenance so source reports TODO_DB_CREDENTIAL_COMMAND. Add tests covering absent-provider parity with today's behavior, read-write success, read-only success, absent-only capability fallback, non-zero exit, timeout, oversized output, missing executable, and assertions that provider stdout and stderr never appear in any exception, doctor JSON, or log line.
description: resolve_credential() in src/todo_db/backends.py currently ends at E_AUTH_MISSING when neither DatabaseConfig.auth_token nor the TODO_DB_* variables are set, so every interactive caller must have a token exported into its process before it starts. Add a fourth, last-resort resolution step that asks a user-configured external provider command for a capability-matched credential. todo-db retrieves and never stores: the token is held in memory for the life of the process, never written to disk, config, logs, doctor output, or tracker evidence, and never minted. When TODO_DB_CREDENTIAL_COMMAND is unset the resolver behaves exactly as it does today, byte for byte, so CI and every existing consumer are unaffected. This is the item that closes the usability gap v0.4.2 opened.

anti_patterns.dont: Add the provider variable to todo-db without adding it to every caller environment filter
anti_patterns.instead: update integrations/pi/src/client.ts getSanitizedEnv in the same item and pin it with a test
anti_patterns.why: an allowlisted-env caller such as the Pi adapter would strip it and reproduce the same silent authentication failure for one agent

anti_patterns.dont: Cache the retrieved token to disk, config, or an environment file so later processes can reuse it
anti_patterns.instead: resolve per process and keep the value in memory only
anti_patterns.why: ADR 0004 forbids todo-db becoming a secret store, and a cached token outlives its rotation

anti_patterns.dont: Give the provider subprocess an unbounded or generous timeout
anti_patterns.instead: use a short default timeout and surface a coded E_AUTH_MISSING on expiry
anti_patterns.why: an interactive or wedged secret store would hang every tracker command instead of failing fast

anti_patterns.dont: Include provider stdout or stderr in an error message, log, or doctor field
anti_patterns.instead: report only argv[0] and the exit status
anti_patterns.why: the provider's stdout is the bearer token and its stderr routinely echoes it back on failure

anti_patterns.dont: Invoke the provider once per statement or connection attempt
anti_patterns.instead: resolve once per process and reuse the ResolvedCredential
anti_patterns.why: the point of this work is to end per-command credential churn, not relocate it

anti_patterns.dont: Let the provider override an explicitly supplied token or environment variable
anti_patterns.instead: consult it only as the last step before E_AUTH_MISSING
anti_patterns.why: CI and deliberate overrides must stay authoritative and reproducible

anti_patterns.dont: Run the provider command through a shell
anti_patterns.instead: parse it with shlex.split and call subprocess.run with shell=False
anti_patterns.why: a shell would make the configured string an injection surface and make failures unpredictable

anti_patterns.dont: Treat a non-zero provider exit as an absent credential
anti_patterns.why: silently continuing would let a broken read-only provider escalate the caller to a read-write credential

preserves.behavior: A rejected credential is never retried with a different capability or a different source; only an absent credential permits read-only to read-write fallback.
DatabaseConfig.auth_token keeps highest precedence and an explicitly supplied environment credential is never overridden by the provider.
TODO_DB_AUTH_CONTRACT=v2 exit mapping is unchanged: exit 4 only when the marker is present, exit 2 with migration guidance otherwise.
The provider adds no work to the local or standalone SQLite path and no work to any caller that already supplies a credential, so the CI and injected-token hot paths are unchanged.
The provider is never consulted for local or standalone SQLite backends.

The provider subprocess is invoked at most once per capability per process and is bounded by a short default timeout, so a stalled or interactive secret store degrades to a coded error rather than a hang.
Token values, provider stdout, and provider stderr are absent from exceptions, tracebacks, doctor output, JSON, logs, workflow output, and test evidence.
With TODO_DB_CREDENTIAL_COMMAND unset, resolution, error text, error codes, and exit statuses are identical to v0.4.2 for every caller including CI.
todo-db still never mints, caches, or persists a bearer token, and never calls the Turso control plane during a normal command.
